name.value: MV Uchuck III (Nootka Sound Service Ltd / Get West)

description.value: The MV Uchuck III is a converted 140-foot working freighter operated by Get West Adventure Cruises (Nootka Sound Service Ltd) out of Gold River, running a Nootka Sound day cruise most Tuesdays year-round (except during the vessel's May refit), a Friendly Cove day cruise with Nootka Trail hiker pickups on Wednesdays and Saturdays (late June–early September), and a Thursday–Friday overnight run to Kyuquot via Esperanza Inlet (June–September). Kayaks and canoes are explicitly welcome aboard; freight capacity is 70 tons, but no bike-specific policy is published — call or email ahead to confirm.
